lines: - Ven'kra: "Coming through that portal was a big mistake, Tenno."
- Ven'kra: "You should have brought more Tenno. You don't have enough."
- Ven'kra: "If you're not careful Tenno, my friend will break your back."
- Ven'kra: "Sprag... wait for the right moment, then deliver the killing blow."
- Ven'kra: "Sprag, calm down. Remember, you must stay focused."
- Ven'kra: "One by one, that is how you die."
- Ven'kra: "Are you willing to die for this key Tenno?"
- Ven'kra: "What have you done to her!?"
- Ven'kra: "She will be remembered! Who will remember you, Tenno?"
- Ven'kra: "Clean and precise. That's how it's done."
